Becca Nolan: Heads-up: AWS marketplace invoice for Oct shows an unexpected discount stacking for reseller NorthStar. The invoice lists a 15% partner discount and a separate 15% promo discount applied to the same line items, resulting in ~ $21k underbilling. pdf: https://s3.redwood.internal/invoices/aws/2026-10/NS-INV-1015.pdf
Samir Gupta: that shouldn't stack. do we have the partner export and discount metadata? cc @Ava Martinez
Ava Martinez: pulling export now. Partner export includes two fields: partner_discount_pct=15 and promo_tag=autumn15. Our ingestion step historically applies partner_discount but promo should be applied as promo_credit (not stackable).
Becca Nolan: can we pause collections for NorthStar until we reconcile? @finance-bot please create a ticket and place provisional hold for $21,000.
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-4852. Provisional hold set for $21,000. Auto-invoicing paused for NorthStar for Oct.
billing-ops: ack. I'll snapshot the ingestion run and re-run with a rule to treat promo_tag as non-stackable. ETA 2h.
aws-marketplace: FYI we changed how promo tags are exported last month to be more explicit; looks like partner used an older export format. We'll send corrected export and a note.
Ava Martinez: quick snippet (redacted):
```
charge_id,sku,net_amount,partner_discount_pct,promo_tag
chr_9988,aws.ml.gpu.large,140000,15,autumn15
```
Our importer applied partner_discount_pct, then also created a promo_credit line for autumn15 and both reduced the net_amount.
Samir Gupta: recommend provisional approval to net up to $22k to cover rounding/adj. Approving $22,000. :+1:
Ava Martinez: re-run finished - confirmed double-apply. Clean import removes promo_credit and restores $21,080 to receivable. I've attached reconciliation and a draft partner memo to FIN-4852.
Becca Nolan: please send partner memo and ask for corrected export. Once partner confirms, ops can lift hold and invoice the corrected amount.
aws-marketplace: corrected export uploaded and partner apologized for old format. we'll coordinate a small exporter version check to avoid repeat.
billing-ops: applied corrected import in prod. credit/collection adjusted. FIN-4852 updated and closed after audit.
Becca Nolan: action item for experiments/product: add exporter version header check and ingestion guardrail for stacking discounts. tagging in FIN-4852. Closing slack thread. :white_check_mark:
